dedupe_keys.name: nauru bureau of statistics 2021 population and housing census household tables 1 to 51 by district with wall floor roof and guttering material and condition drinking water source groundwater use water storage tank material and capacity downpipes electricity source nuc grid generator solar prepaid meters lighting waste disposal internet and households affected by drought floods storm surge and king tides

description: The Nauru Bureau of Statistics posted the 2021 Population and Housing Census report files on its website, and the household tables file holds 51 tables of private dwelling households by district, covering the 14 districts and the Location settlement. Housing tables give wall, floor and roof material and the material and condition of guttering. A long water section covers drinking and cooking water, use of underground water, water storage tank material and capacity, downpipes connected to tanks, supply that dries up and the fallback source. Energy tables give the main source of electricity, where almost all of 2,021 households use the government supply, plus prepaid meters, energy efficiency and lighting. Later tables cover waste disposal, internet access, climate change awareness and households affected by drought, floods, storm surge and king tides. Coverage is national. Format and access: free PDF and an XLSX of mostly population tables, no registration; PopGIS3 shows census tables and maps. Licence: no licence statement was found. Caveats: tables are PDF layout, and the old nbs.gov.nr address failed from the cloud while the office now uses stats.gov.nr. Simulation uses: rainwater tank storage and disaster exposure by district for drought and coastal flooding studies on a small island. Related records: the SPC Pacific Data Hub census household counts with electricity access.
